name: collection-review
title: Collection access and content review
for_each: select id,code from collections order by code

sections.title: Document position
sections.sql: select d.external_id,d.title,d.owner,d.status,d.review_on,d.retention_review_on,r.searchable from documents d join document_register r on r.id=d.id where d.collection_id=$1 order by d.external_id

name: retention-review
title: Document retention review worksheet
for_each: select id,external_id from documents where status<>'archived' order by external_id

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select actor,note,content_hash,review_on,retention_review_on,created_at from reviews where document_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status,resolution from actions where document_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: A human decides retention and any legal hold. This worksheet does not authorise destruction.
